description.value: A Dairy Queen Grill & Chill franchise in Chilliwack on South Fraser Way, serving burgers and ice cream treats. As a full-format DQ location with drive-through, it is a convenient stop for a quick meal or a Blizzard on a long ride. Touring cyclists passing through the South Fraser Way corridor will find it easy to access from the road.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 67m. Total: 3 spaces.

concerns: Website fetch blocked by Cloudflare — no amenity or contact details could be verified from the website. All fields except Takeout (from OSM tags) remain null.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible fast food chain location on a main road in Chilliwack. Useful to touring cyclists for food and a rest stop.
